text: Applicant data and documents can be processed via RESTful APIs
quote: With the Sumsub API, you can process the applicant data and documents submitted for verification through simple RESTful APIs.

text: Sandbox mode lets you test integrations before going live
quote: Use Sandbox mode to test your integration before going live.

text: Webhooks automatically notify you of applicant verification events and status changes
quote: Sumsub’s Webhooks is a tool that allows you to automatically receive notifications for various events and changes related to your applicants’ verification process.

text: An MCP server lets AI agents perform Sumsub operations under your existing role permissions
quote: Use the MCP server to let AI agents perform Sumsub operations on your behalf, while keeping access controlled by your existing Sumsub role permissions.

text: Verification 'levels' define configurable multi-step flows including docs, selfie, liveness, video, questionnaire, and payment checks
quote: A level is a sequence of steps that your applicants have to take to verify their identity. Each level may include document-based or selfie-based verification, Liveness & Face match, Short video fragment, Questionnaire, Payment methods, and

text: AML screening can be configured against targeted lists/categories with adjustable fuzziness
quote: Configure your AML screening settings to suit your needs by screening against targeted lists and categories that are relevant to your business, and adjust fuzziness levels to suit.

text: Web and Mobile SDKs can be customized with brand colors, styles, and instructions
quote: Tailor colors, styles, and step instructions to match your brand across Web and Mobile SDKs.

text: Team members can be granted access to the Sumsub account
quote: Grant your team members access to your Sumsub account.

text: Security keys or biometrics can be used to protect account access
quote: Generate a security key or use biometric options to reduce the risk of account compromise.

text: Reusable KYC lets clients share verification data via agreement and reuse applicant data across checks
quote: With Reusable KYC, you can conclude an agreement with other Sumsub clients to share verification data, and enable applicant data reuse to complete your specific verification checks.

text: Supports instant verification of 14,000+ document types from 220+ countries and territories
quote: Instantly verify 14,000+ document types from 220+ countries and territories.

text: Liveness check confirms a real live person in under a second, detecting deepfakes, AI-generated images, paper masks, screen photos, and dolls
quote: In under a second, it confirms the applicant is a real, live person (not a deepfake, AI-generated image, paper mask, photo of a screen, or doll) and matches them to the account and documents on file.

text: Liveness check results for an applicant can be reviewed in the Applicant profile UI
quote: Open the Applicants page and select an applicant who passed the Liveness check. In the profile, navigate to the Liveness section and review the results.
